variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: While the quarter loads, the tiles and charts render their own Skeleton and the goals and commentary hold Skeleton rows, so the page does not reflow when data arrives.

variants.name: Empty
variants.summary: A quarter with nothing reported. The tiles show a dash with no delta, and one bordered page-level EmptyState names the quarter and offers the next later one in place of the trend cards, goals and commentary.

variants.name: Error
variants.summary: The request for the quarter failed: one danger `Alert` under the page heading names what did not load and offers Retry; the tiles read as dashes over a quiet band and every card keeps its header over a quiet `Not available.` line.
